The $4,900 Reason to Ditch Your Debit Card
youtube_short.description: Most people think their debit card is the responsible, safe choice — but if your account gets drained, federal law might not protect a single dollar. Credit cards cap your fraud liability at $50 by law, and most cards make it zero. Debit cards can leave you fully exposed after just 60 days, and your bank has 10 full business days to investigate while your cash sits frozen. The fix is free — use credit, pay it off monthly. #debitcard #creditcard #personalfinance #moneytips #bankingscam
